checks.text: The page shows the heading "Appointment Booking" and a month grid for the current month with the text "No appointments yet" visible in the empty state area.

Clicking the button "New appointment" opens a dialog with fields labelled "Client name", "Date", "Start time", "End time", and "Notes". Typing "Jane Doe" in "Client name", selecting "2025-06-15" in "Date", "09:00" in "Start time", "10:00" in "End time", and "Initial consultation" in "Notes", then clicking "Save" adds an appointment; the month grid shows a block labelled "Jane Doe" on June 15 and the text "No appointments yet" is gone.

After the appointment from A2 exists, clicking the "Week" tab shows a week view for the week containing June 15, 2025, with a time slot at 09:00 on Monday June 15 displaying "Jane Doe" and "Initial consultation".

In the week view, clicking the "Jane Doe" block opens the appointment detail dialog showing "Client name: Jane Doe", "Date: 2025-06-15", "Start time: 09:00", "End time: 10:00", and "Notes: Initial consultation". Changing "End time" to "11:00" and clicking "Save" updates the block in the week view to show "09:00 – 11:00".
In the appointment detail dialog for "Jane Doe", clicking "Delete" removes the appointment; the week view no longer shows the "Jane Doe" block, and the month grid shows "No appointments yet".

Clicking the "Settings" tab shows a form with fields labelled "Day of week", "Start time", and "End time". Selecting "Monday" in "Day of week", "08:00" in "Start time", and "17:00" in "End time", and clicking "Save availability" shows a confirmation text "Availability saved for Monday".

After saving Monday availability from A6, clicking the "Export ICS" button triggers a file download named "appointments.ics" whose content includes the line "BEGIN:VEVENT" and the text "Jane Doe" if an appointment exists, or only "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" and "END:VCALENDAR" if no appointments exist.
Typing "Jane" in the search field labelled "Search appointments" filters the month grid to show only the "Jane Doe" block; typing "zzz" shows "No appointments match".

Reload keeps the appointment "Jane Doe" on 2025-06-15 and the Monday availability setting; after reload, the month grid shows "Jane Doe" on June 15 and the Settings tab shows "Monday" with "08:00" and "17:00".
